from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u050/system/state/workspace')
programs=base/'programs'
programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    lines = set()
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg:
            lines.update((r, c) for c in range(w))
    for c in range(w):
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        if len(set(vals)) == 1 and vals[0] != bg:
            lines.update((r, c) for r in range(h))
    return [[2 if (r, c) in lines else grid[r][c] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
